newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says first-quarter profits, orders rise.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says first-quarter profits, orders rise.

text.p: Swedish mobile phone giant Ericsson SpA Friday reported a 30 percent rise in first-quarter profits after financial items to 2.02 billion crowns ($263 million), slightly higher than the market expected.
The group also said that its first-quarter mobile systems order bookings rose 22 percent and that its mobile phones and terminals sales rose almost 100 percent.

"Even measured in the increasingly stronger U.S. dollar, order bookings and net sales increased sharply during the first quarter, by 19 percent and 21 percent, respectively," Chief Executive Officer Lars Ramqvist said.
"Subscriber growth, particularly for digital systems, is very rapid throughout the world," the company said of the mobile systems business.
